scoring.rule: Repeatability = sd of a parameter across recordings (lower is better). Every row whose key is in scored_keys is scored for every method that estimates it; a parameter held fixed by design (Kalibr's camera+IMU intrinsics, baseline and GS readout) or shown only (Basalt with a different camera model) is excluded for that method. Per row, best = min sd over the methods with n >= 2; rel = min(sd / best, tau_max); no data = tau_max. Family score = mean rel over the method's scored rows; a family with no such row is not applicable (null) and left out. Dataset score = mean of the family scores over the dataset's families; a family the method did not run counts tau_max. On camera-only families both MVIS methods are the same camera solve (they differ only in the IMU model). Rank ascending.

T6c.title: 3 GS cameras — camera calibration
T6c.subtitle: april 01–10 · Kalibr kalibr_calibrate_cameras, 3 cameras jointly
T6c.caveat: MVIS has no separate T6 camera-only regression row: the MVIS column is the camera calibration of the T6 camera + IMU rows (calyx model, intrinsics refined in cam-IMU), against Kalibr's 10 camera-only runs.
T6c.bas_caveat: Basalt: t265 pair (kb4, fisheye 2 snapped onto fisheye 1) and Blackfly alone (pinhole-radtan8, a different model from radtan: its intrinsics are shown, not counted); no camera-only Basalt run holds both devices, so no baselines to the Blackfly.

T6.title: 3 GS cameras + 4 IMUs
T6.subtitle: april 01–10 · Kalibr 3 cameras + 4 IMUs jointly
T6.bas_caveat: No Basalt row: Basalt cannot calibrate T6 — one IMU per run (the rig has four) and frames grouped by exact stamp (the t265 pair and the Blackfly share none), so no single run holds the rig.

T1.title: t265 GS fisheye stereo
T1.subtitle: bags 01–15 (bag 09 excluded) · Kalibr pinhole-equi
T1.bas_caveat: Basalt groups stereo frames by stamp and the t265 pair never shares one, so its fisheye 2 frames are snapped onto fisheye 1's (1.8–5 ms apart).

T2.title: ELP RS stereo + readout
T2.subtitle: bags 01–15 · Kalibr pinhole-radtan-rs, one camera per run
T2.caveat: Kalibr's rolling-shutter model calibrates one camera at a time, so it has no ELP stereo baseline. ELP-R bags 8 and 13 failed (autodiff overflow at bag-freq 15; the bag-freq-10 retry overflowed again on bag 8 and converged to a non-physical basin on bag 13) and are excluded.
T2.bas_caveat: Basalt has no rolling-shutter model: it solves the ELP pair as global shutter with pinhole-radtan8 (seeded from kb4), so its T2 values are shown but not counted. Since 2026-11-01 MVIS solves the ELP with the equidistant model while the Kalibr RS runs are radtan: intrinsics and readout are compared, distortion coefficients are MVIS only.

T7.title: Mixed t265-f1 + ELP-L, aux Xsens
T7.subtitle: bags 01–15 · Kalibr with ELP-L as global shutter (bag 8 excluded)
T7.caveat: MVIS solves t265 fisheye 1 (GS) + ELP-L (rolling shutter, readout estimated) + both IMUs. Kalibr's camera + IMU solver is global-shutter only, so its runs (imu_mixed_bag1–15_elpgs) take ELP-L as a GS camera and its readout tr is reported as 0 (its model, not counted). Kalibr bag 8 is excluded: its base gyro scales (1.23 / 2.23) are far from the other 14 bags (about 1.01), a failed solve; MVIS bag 8 stays in the all-n line.
T7.bas_caveat: No Basalt row: Basalt cannot calibrate T7 — no rolling-shutter model for ELP-L, one IMU per run, and one time offset shared by all cameras (the t265 and ELP clocks share no frame stamps).

T8.title: ELP RS stereo + two IMUs (IMUs only)
T8.subtitle: MVIS bags 1–3 vs the Kalibr T7 runs on the same bags
T8.caveat: *No RS-anchored Kalibr run exists: Kalibr's camera + IMU solver cannot use the ELP rolling-shutter cameras. T8's IMUs (t265 base, Xsens aux) are the same physical IMUs on the same bags as T7, so they are compared with the Kalibr T7 runs (anchored on t265 fisheye 1). Its ELP cameras have no Kalibr counterpart and are listed with MVIS values only.
T8.bas_caveat: No Basalt run for this family: Basalt has no rolling-shutter model.
